items.t: Alphabet Stocks Rise 1.19% as Gemini 4 Hydrogen and $395 AI Glasses Launch
items.sum: Google made a faster, cheaper Gemini model its everyday default and opened preorders for Samsung-built smart glasses shipping December 10.

items.t: If You Invest $1,000 in Alphabet Today, Here’s What It Could Be Worth by 2030
items.sum: Alphabet just doubled Google Cloud sales and grew revenue 25%, yet the stock sank nearly 17% in a month. One model maps three very different outcomes for a $1,000 stake, and the gap between best and worst case is striking.

items.t: State Street Comm Services SPDR (XLC) Adds Meta and Alphabet on Nov. 11
items.sum: The fund bought $84.3 million of stock, lifting 21 positions and trimming none, with Meta and both Alphabet share classes the largest additions.

items.t: Goldman Sachs S&P 500 Premium Income (GPIX) Adds Alphabet and Apple on Nov. 11
items.sum: The fund bought $86.9 million of stock and sold nothing, lifting 117 positions.

items.t: 42 ETFs Add to Alphabet (GOOG) on Wednesday
items.sum: ETFs bought $78.6 million of Alphabet (GOOG) shares, with 42 buyers against 12 sellers.
